subject: Logic
title: The Bootstrap Paradox
description: A quick, practical guide to The Bootstrap Paradox.

hook.text: A time traveler gives Beethoven his own symphonies before he writes them. Who composed them?

buildup.text: The bootstrap paradox arises when an object or information exists in a causal loop with no origin.

discovery.text: The symphonies were never created—just passed around in a loop. They exist without a creator.

twist.text: This doesn't violate physics directly, but it violates our sense that everything needs an origin.

climax.text: If time travel is possible, causation might not be linear. Effects could precede their causes.

punchline.text: No origin, but it exists anyway.

quiz.question: What makes the bootstrap paradox troubling?
